description: We turn lunar data into mission decisions. We're a 3-person İstanbul team: a lead working on edge AI and space data (papers at IEEE HPEC and IAC 2026), an electronics and software builder (PCB, C#, Python, C++), and a strategist handling storytelling and delivery. Roles are clear from hour one, so we ship a working demo, not just slides. Our focus is the Lunar Landing Site Navigator: showing not just where the Sun and Earth are, but whether a south-pole mission survives.
